svg.title: The vault map: every note a point, placed so related notes sit together, coloured by cluster and named from the notes themselves
svg.text: A map of your whole vault
Every note is a point. Nothing was tagged or foldered to make this: the positions and the cluster names both come out of the notes.
CLUSTERS FOUND, AND NAMED, BY THE PLUGIN
433 notes from the lab vault behind every figure here. Cluster purity 0.65, against 0.29 for a shuffled baseline, so the grouping is not chance.
